name: glide-studio-angular
description: Build tooling for Glide Studio's SCSS source (scss/app.scss -> css/app.css) and the vendored js-beautify used by DeployService to format exported widget code to ServiceNow's standard. No runtime dependency in the deployed widget - both dev/authoring-only. js-beautify is vendored at lib/beautify.js (self-contained); this dep just records its origin/version for regenerating that file. The shared deploy-packaging core is NOT vendored - it's referenced directly from /tools/packager via the single ServiceNow-root dev server (see index.html).
